title: External spur-gear hydraulic pump (Group-1 size)
one_line: Two 12-tooth m2 spur gears in a figure-8 cavity, split body with dowelled front and rear covers, sleeve-bushed shafts, keyed drive shaft with lip seal, M8 through-bolts and port adapters; both gears on revolutes driven from one angle parameter.
specs: Gears: module 2, 12 teeth, 20 deg pressure angle, 18 mm face width, 24 mm centre distance, tip dia 27.6 mm, 0.25 mm design backlash; polyline involute flanks
Cavity: two 28 mm bores, 0.2 mm radial tip clearance, 0.1 mm end float per side
Ports: inlet 13 mm (+x), outlet 10 mm (-x), straight adapters with bonded seals; drive turns clockwise seen from the shaft end
Shafts 14 mm in four 14x16x10 sleeve bushings; 5x5x20 parallel key; 14x24x7 lip seal in a 32 mm pilot
Covers on four 5x12 dowel pins, two face O-rings (about 56x3), four M8x45 SHCS with washers
Front mounting flange 104 x 92 mm, four 9 mm holes; body 64 x 80 x 18.2 mm
parameters: theta (drive gear angle; drive revolute = theta, idler revolute = 15 deg - theta)
interference: 84 pairs at theta=0 deg and 82 pairs at theta=10 deg, 0 interferences
poses: theta = 0 deg: solve converged (well, 0 dof), 0 interferences
theta = 10 deg: solve converged (well, 0 dof), 0 interferences; saved pose, used for hero and detail renders
not_verified: No flow, pressure rating, efficiency, torque or mass computed (displacement is a geometric textbook estimate only)
Gear coupling is geometric only: ryucad has no gear-ratio mate, both revolutes are driven from theta by expression
Tooth profile is a polyline involute with a radial flank below the base circle, no generated undercut or profile shift
3D interference checked at two poses only; the full-pitch sweep is a 2D outline check (smallest gap 0.117 mm)
Threads, trapped-volume relief grooves and pressure-balanced bushings not modelled; port adapters, bonded seals and lip seal simplified; O-rings modelled pre-squeezed
